subject: Frederia
text: The recommended level for Frederia is 43.

evidence.quote:
FREDERIA [FRED1]
Recommended Level: 43

subject: Frederia Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Frederia costs 50 gold.

evidence.quote: FREDERIA [FRED1] Recommended Level: 43 Treasure: Grilled Newt, Miracle, Revive, Stone Cure Enemies: Griffon, Mad Wolf, Mega Frog (Ice), Megaturtle (Ice) =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 50

subject: Frederia
text: A hidden Grilled Newt is located at the center of the 3x3 flower bed below the inn.

evidence.quote: The inn is to the left of the entrance.  Below it is a 3x3 flower bed with a hidden GRILLED NEWT at the center.

subject: Frederia
text: A hidden Miracle is located at the center of the 3x3 flower bed in the lower right corner of town.

evidence.quote: In the lower right corner of town is the same thing with a hidden MIRACLE at the center.

subject: Frederia
text: Lockers in the basement of the building on the hill contain a Revive and a Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Examine the lockers to the left which contain a REVIVE and STONE CURE.

subject: Frederia
text: Lockers to the left in the basement of the building on the hill contain a Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Examine the lockers to the left which contain a REVIVE and STONE CURE.

subject: Falcon
text: Talking to Raile with the Power Oil refits the Falcon with the ability to fly.

evidence.quote: Talk to Raile with the Power Oil and he will refit the Falcon so you can fly.

subject: Dragon Shrine
text: At the Dragon Shrine southwest of Herat, 8 Dragon Eggs can be exchanged for either 2 levels for everyone, 3 of each stat-boosting potion, a Might Shield, or a Might Bow.

evidence.quote:
First, warp back to Herat and fly southwest to the Dragon Shrine.  You can exchange the 8 Dragon Eggs for one of a few rewards:

1) Everyone gains 2 levels.
2) You get 3 of each stat-boosting potion.
3) A Might Shield.
4) A Might Bow.

subject: Dragon Eggs
text: Making a wish scatters the Dragon Eggs across eight treasure chests worldwide, permanently erasing any original contents of those chests if they were not collected beforehand.

evidence.quote: After doing so, the Dragon Eggs will scatter across the world to eight treasure chests.  If you missed those treasure chests earlier, their original contents will be gone forever.

subject: Arubus
text: The recommended level for Arubus is 43.

evidence.quote:
ARUBUS [ARUB1]
Recommended Level: 43

subject: Arubus Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Arubus costs 150 gold.

evidence.quote: ARUBUS [ARUB1] Recommended Level: 43 Treasure: Spell Potion, Pear Cider, Plum Cider Enemies: Efreet (Water), Mad Knight (Thunder), Mad Wolf, Mega Frog (Ice) =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 150

subject: Arubus
text: A bookshelf in the upper left corner of the inn contains a Spell Potion.

evidence.quote: The inn is conveniently right at the entrance.  Examine the bookshelf in the upper left corner which contains a SPELL POTION.

subject: Arubus
text: A chest down the steps inside the cave in Arubus contains a Pear Cider.

evidence.quote: Enter the cave to the left.  Climb down the steps to find two chests which contain a PEAR CIDER and PLUM CIDER.

subject: Arubus
text: A chest down the steps inside the cave in Arubus contains a Plum Cider.

evidence.quote: Enter the cave to the left.  Climb down the steps to find two chests which contain a PEAR CIDER and PLUM CIDER.

subject: Apple Cider
text: Giving Apple Cider to the man outside Arubus reveals that the Glasdar Key is in the northern cave.

evidence.quote: Give it to the man outside and he will tell you it is in the northern cave.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: The recommended level for North Glasdar Cave is 43.

evidence.quote:
NORTH GLASDAR CAVE [NGDC1]
Recommended Level: 43

subject: Barient
text: A Bolt spell is effective for defeating high-HP Barients in North Glasdar Cave.

evidence.quote: Of the new enemies, you'll probably need a Bolt spell to take out a Barient with their high HP.

subject: Gorgon
text: Gorgons can petrify party members, but they can be defeated with a Thunder spell.

evidence.quote: Gorgons can petrify you, but taken out by a Thunder spell.

subject: Zaurus Rex
text: Zaurus Rex can be eliminated by casting a Vulcan spell.

evidence.quote: Zaurus Rex can also be wiped out by a Vulcan spell.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest along the straightforward opening path in North Glasdar Cave contains a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Follow the straight-forward path to a chest which contains a HI POTION.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest to the left of the ladder past the first bridge contains a Hi Bomb.

evidence.quote: Climb down a ladder and walk left to a chest which contains a HI BOMB.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest heading downward from the Hi Bomb chest contains a Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: Head down to another chest which contains a GLOOM ARROW.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest to the right after continuing down the next ladder contains a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote: Continue down the next ladder and right to a chest which contains a SMOKE BALL.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest to the left of the ladder contains a Magic Guard.

evidence.quote: From the ladder, go left to a chest which contains a MAGIC GUARD.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest heading down on the plateau accessed via the upper left path contains a Mystery Pin.

evidence.quote: Take the upper left path to a ladder to the plateau.  Head down to a chest which contains a MYSTERY PIN.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest to the left on the plateau contains a Zircon Sword.

evidence.quote: Then, walk left to a chest which contains a ZIRCON SWORD (save for later).

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest under the bridge contains a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Go up and under the bridge to a chest which contains a GREAT POTION.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest in the room to the left contains a White Ring providing ATP+40, DFP+21, and AGL+4.

evidence.quote: Enter the room to the left with a chest which contains a WHITE RING (ATP+40, DFP+21, AGL+4, equip on Hero).

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest reached via the warp point through the right door on the basement level contains a Mind Potion.

evidence.quote: There are two doors above you.  Take the right one down a hall to a warp point to a chest which contains a MIND POTION.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: Taking the left door and going down two ladders and left leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Walk back to the doors and take the left one this time.  Follow the path down two ladders, then left to a chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: Continuing down the next two ladders nearby leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Continue down the next two ladders nearby to another chest which contains a Miracle.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: Going back up two ladders, down the ladder to the right, and down leads to a chest in the lower left corner containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Go back up two ladders, then down the one to the right, and down to a chest in the lower left corner which contains yet another MIRACLE.

subject: Basement switch
text: Flipping the switch down in the room above reroutes the basement warp point to a room with a Spell Potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the room above and flip the switch down.  Return to the two doors and enter the right door to a room with the warp point.  Now, it will take you to a chest which contains a SPELL POTION.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest accessed via the rerouted warp point contains a Spell Potion.

evidence.quote: Now, it will take you to a chest which contains a SPELL POTION.

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest down the steps in the basement contains a Power Potion.

evidence.quote: Finally, go down the steps to a room with three chests which contain a POWER POTION, the GLASDAR KEY, and GLOOM GUARD (sell).

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest down the steps in the basement of North Glasdar Cave contains the Glasdar Key.

evidence.quote: Finally, go down the steps to a room with three chests which contain a POWER POTION, the GLASDAR KEY, and GLOOM GUARD (sell).

subject: North Glasdar Cave
text: A chest down the steps in the basement contains a Gloom Guard.

evidence.quote: Finally, go down the steps to a room with three chests which contain a POWER POTION, the GLASDAR KEY, and GLOOM GUARD (sell).

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: The recommended level for Cave to Glasdar Tower is 45.

evidence.quote:
CAVE TO GLASDAR TOWER [CTGT1]
Recommended Level: 45

subject: Dragon
text: Dragons have high HP and should be countered with Thunder and strong single-target attacks.

evidence.quote: Of the new enemies, Dragon has a ton of HP, so throw Thunder and your strongest single-targeting attacks at it.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: From the entrance, heading right, down the ladder, and right leads to a chest containing an Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: From the entrance, head right, down the ladder, and right to a chest which contains an EX BOMB.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest inside the left room down the next ladder contains the Black Ring providing ATP+10, DFP+7, AGL+10, and MGR+40.

evidence.quote: Go down the next ladder and into the left room below to a chest which contains the BLACK RING (ATP+10, DFP+7, AGL+10, MGR+40, equip on Aguro).

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A hidden Power Potion can be found by casting Float and searching the swamp outside.

evidence.quote: Back outside, cast Float, and search the swamp for a hidden POWER POTION.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest located upward from the swamp contains Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Head up to a chest which contains an EX ARROWS.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Heading left, up the ladder, right, and up leads to a chest containing a Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Go left, up the ladder, right, and up to a chest which contains a STONE CURE.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest inside the right room on the next level contains a Hi Magic.

evidence.quote: From the ladder, climb up the next one to a room.  Enter the next door and into the right room with a chest which contains a HI MAGIC.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the room up the left ladder contains Sonic Heels.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and climb the left ladder up to a room with a chest which contains a SONIC HEELS.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest outside the lower left door contains a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote: Leave through the lower left door and open the nearby chest which contains a SMOKE BALL.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest inside the left room contains a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: In the left room, open the chest which contains a HI POTION.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Proceeding left past the ladders leads to a chest containing an Antidote.

evidence.quote: Exit the room, climb down the long ladder, down the next left ladder, and proceed left to a chest which contains an ANTIDOTE.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest inside the nearby room in the middle of the cave contains a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the nearby room with a chest which contains a GREAT POTION.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest outside near the room in the middle of the cave contains a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and open the nearby chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Climbing down the ladder near the room leads to a chest containing a Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: Climb down the ladder to another chest which contains a GLOOM ARROW.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest up the leftmost ladder from the room contains a Mind Gourd.

evidence.quote: From the room, walk all the way to the leftmost ladder up to a chest which contains a MIND GOURD.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the room reached through either door contains an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Take either door up to the next room with two chests which contain an EX POTION and BIG ARROW.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the room reached through either door contains a Big Arrow.

evidence.quote: Take either door up to the next room with two chests which contain an EX POTION and BIG ARROW.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Leaving the rooms, going down the ladder, and walking left leads to a chest containing a Dragon Arrow.

evidence.quote: Leave the rooms, go down the ladder, and left to a chest which contains a DRAGON ARROW.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest up the left ladder contains an Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: Climb the left ladder up to a chest which contains an EX BOMB.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Walking all the way right, up the ladder, and all the way right again leads to a chest containing Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Walk all the way to the right, up the ladder, and all the way to the right again to a chest which contains EX ARROWS.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Chests to the right and left inside the upper room contain 2 Miracles.

evidence.quote: Open the chest to the right and left which contain 2 MIRACLES.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: A chest on the left side of the swamp, accessed with Float, contains a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Cast Float, and search the left side of the swamp for a chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: Glasdar Key
text: Using the Glasdar Key on the door opens the path across the cave to Glasdar Tower.

evidence.quote: Use the Glasdar Key on the door to reach the other side of the cave and outside to the tower.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: The recommended level for Glasdar Tower is 46.

evidence.quote:
GLASDAR TOWER [GLST1]
Recommended Level: 46

subject: Glasdar Tower Enemies
text: Lufia's Thunder spell and Jerin's physical attacks are effective against Electromaz, Fire Wave, Waterspout, and Whirlwind.

evidence.quote: Of the new enemies, Electromaz, Fire Wave, Waterspout, and Whirlwind all have high damage elemental spells.  Lufia's Thunder spell will be most useful against them, as will Jerin's physical attack.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: On the first floor of Glasdar Tower, the room to the left contains a chest with a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: On the first floor, there is a room to the left and right, each with a chest which contain a HI POTION and EX BOMB.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: On the first floor of Glasdar Tower, the room to the right contains a chest with an Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: On the first floor, there is a room to the left and right, each with a chest which contain a HI POTION and EX BOMB.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the right room on the second floor contains a Big Arrow.

evidence.quote: Enter the room to the right with a chest which contains a BIG ARROW.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the room accessed through the hallway door on the second floor contains Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Head left and go through the next door.  Go right to a room with a chest which contains EX ARROWS.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the left room on the third floor contains a Revive.

evidence.quote: First, check out the left room with a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the right room on the third floor contains a Mind Gourd.

evidence.quote: Then, enter the right room with two chests which contain an MIND GOURD and POWER GOURD.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the right room on the third floor contains a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Then, enter the right room with two chests which contain an MIND GOURD and POWER GOURD.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: Walking down on the other side of the third floor leads to a chest containing a Revive.

evidence.quote: From the stairs, go up to the hallway and left into the other side of the floor.  Walk down where you will see a chest which contains a REVIVE.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest in the main area of the fourth floor contains an Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: Head up to the main area with a chest which contains an EX BOMB.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: Heading through the lower right door and left on the fourth floor leads to a chest containing a Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: The door above is a dead-end, so go through the lower right door and left to a chest which contains a GLOOM ARROW.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: Chests along the path down through the door contain a Miracle and a Gloom Ring.

evidence.quote: Proceed down through the door and along the path to two chests which contain a MIRACLE and GLOOM RING.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest along the path down through the door on the fourth floor contains a Gloom Ring.

evidence.quote: Proceed down through the door and along the path to two chests which contain a MIRACLE and GLOOM RING.

subject: Glasdar Tower
text: A chest before the stairs to the fifth floor contains an Antidote.

evidence.quote: Proceed down to a chest which contains an ANTIDOTE, then down to the stairs to the fifth floor.

subject: Warp switches
text: On the sixth floor, stepping on the right two switches alters the warp point destination to a Miracle chest and a treasure trove of 10 chests.

evidence.quote: Step on the right two and take the warp point to a chest which contains a MIRACLE.  Follow the path up through a couple rooms and a hallway to a treasure trove with 10 chests which contain 4 MIRACLES, POWER POTION, GREAT POTION, SPEED POTION, SPELL POTION, MIND POTION, and REVIVE.

subject: Warp switches
text: Resetting the switches and stepping on the right switch changes the warp point destination to a Stun Arrow chest.

evidence.quote: Reset them with the red carpet switch, step on the right of the three switches, and take the warp point to a chest which contains a STUN ARROW.

subject: Warp switches
text: Resetting the switches and stepping on none of them directs the warp point to a Miracle chest.

evidence.quote: Reset the switches, don't step on any of them, and take the warp point to a chest which contains a MIRACLE.

subject: Warp switches
text: Resetting the switches and stepping on the middle switch sends the warp point to the path leading to the roof.

evidence.quote: Reset the switches, step and the middle one, and use the warp point.  Follow the straight-forward path to the roof, equip Lufia with her Flash Ring, and step on the lower switch.

subject: Arubus
text: Apple Cider can be bought for 1000 gold on the bottom level of the cave in Arubus.

evidence.quote:
Apple Cider   1000...Continue down to the bottom 
level where you can buy the Apple Cider.
